svg.text: Arduino Uno + SSD1306 OLED + green and red LEDs (1k resistors) + 2 push buttons. Colored dots = connected holes.
Green LED to D11, red LED to D10. Green button to A0, red button to A3 (other side to GND). OLED SDA to A4, SCL to A5.
Use pinMode(A0 / A3, INPUT_PULLUP) in the sketch. Pressed = LOW.
